claim: i18next achieves type safety via module augmentation of CustomTypeOptions with a declared resources type; v25.4+ adds enableSelector for better IDE performance.
quote: This approach uses Type Augmentation and Merging Interfaces to customize type behavior... keySeparator (default '.'), nsSeparator (default ':')... Version 25.4+ introduced the enableSelector option.

claim: react-i18next documents a d.ts declaration file augmenting i18next with defaultNS and resources to type the t() function.
quote: add an i18next.d.ts file to augment the TypeScript definition, importing your namespace files and declaring a CustomTypeOptions interface with the defaultNS and resources.

claim: react-i18next TypeScript support requires a separate declaration file and is less ergonomic than react-intl; Lingui co-locates messages but needs an SWC/Babel build plugin.
quote: react-i18next provides TypeScript support that requires a separate declaration file and is less ergonomic than react-intl... LinguiJS: Messages are co-located with components. No jumping between files. However, it requires a build plugin (SWC or Babel macro).

claim: Lingui extracts messages via static analysis of t/Trans macros using lingui extract; cannot extract from variables, and supports dependency-tree crawling for per-page catalogs.
quote: Macros are JavaScript transformers that run at build time... The extractor recognizes t and Trans macro calls automatically... It cannot extract messages from variables or function calls.

claim: Lingui provides a CLI that extracts and merges messages with existing translations, supporting Babel and SWC, versus react-intl needing manual merge.
quote: Lingui provides a CLI that extracts and merges messages with existing translations, supporting both Babel and SWC ecosystems.

claim: js-lingui is a readable, automated, optimized 2kb i18n library with CLI, Vite plugin, and ESLint plugin.
quote: A readable, automated, and optimized (2 kb) internationalization for JavaScript

claim: Paraglide JS is a compiler-based i18n library emitting tree-shakable typed message functions, up to 70% smaller bundles.
quote: Compiler-based i18n library that emits tree-shakable translations, leading to up to 70% smaller bundle sizes.

claim: Paraglide types keys and parameters by default so a renamed or missing message is a compile error, versus react-i18next's opt-in augmentation you maintain.
quote: keys and parameters are typed by default — a renamed or missing message is a compile error... react-i18next requires optional TypeScript augmentation... opt-in setup you maintain rather than something you get for free.

claim: Paraglide compiles messages into typed ESM functions enabling Vite tree-shaking and TypeScript autocomplete of keys and parameters; plugin-based message format (ICU or i18next/JSON).
quote: Paraglide compiles messages into typed ESM functions before your app ships, allowing Vite to tree-shake unused translations and TypeScript to autocomplete message keys and parameters.

claim: typesafe-i18n is a zero-dependency, fully type-safe i18n library whose generator outputs TypeScript definitions and wrappers from the base locale.
quote: A fully type-safe and lightweight internationalization library for all your TypeScript and JavaScript projects.

claim: typesafe-i18n runs a generator that creates boilerplate wrappers in development mode for full type safety.
quote: creates boilerplate code for you... Most of the magic happens in development mode, where the generator creates TypeScript definitions for your translations.

claim: next-intl generates a .d.json.ts declaration via createMessagesDeclaration to strictly type message keys against the default locale.
quote: Messages can be strictly typed... next-intl can generate an accompanying .d.json.ts file for the messages... you provide the path to the messages in the createMessagesDeclaration option.

claim: next-intl 4.0 lets you declare a Locale type in AppConfig so useLocale() and Link pick up the app-specific locale type.
quote: In next-intl@4.0, you can strictly type locales across your app by declaring a Locale type in the AppConfig interface.

claim: next-intl documents official VSCode integration for its i18n workflow.
quote: VSCode integration – Internationalization (i18n) for Next.js

claim: i18n Ally is an all-in-one i18n VS Code extension supporting inline annotations and missing-key management across many frameworks including i18next, react-intl, and Lingui.
quote: All in one i18n extension for VS Code

claim: i18n Ally shows translations as inline annotations, offers one-click translate of missing/stale keys, and stale-translation detection via regex key/usage matching.
quote: translations are shown as inline annotations after the key... One-click translate all missing and stale keys... Stale Translation Detection.

claim: react-intl (FormatJS) provides runtime ICU message formatting for React.

claim: FormatJS uses defineMessages returning Record<string, MessageDescriptor> as the hook for CLI, Babel, and TS plugins to extract and type messages.
quote: The defineMessages function takes a Record<string, MessageDescriptor> and returns the same type, serving as a hook for CLI, Babel, and TypeScript plugins to extract messages.

claim: FormatJS CLI extracts from defineMessages/FormattedMessage with hash-based ID interpolation and offers a verify command with --missing-keys and --extra-keys for completeness.
quote: The formatjs verify command checks translation completeness: --missing-keys Identifies untranslated strings, --extra-keys Detects obsolete translations... --id-interpolation-pattern default [sha512:contenthash:base64:6].

claim: 2026 comparison rates typesafe-i18n best-in-class type safety, Paraglide/next-intl fully typed with autocomplete, react-intl and react-i18next only 'good' with manual setup.
quote: typesafe-i18n: Fully type-safe with code generation... next-intl: Keys are fully typed with autocomplete; compile-time errors for missing keys... react-intl (FormatJS): No native TypeScript guarantees highlighted.

claim: 2026 rankings: next-intl full key autocompletion without codegen; Paraglide/typesafe-i18n compile-time codegen with parameter-level checks; Lingui macro extraction 'genuinely fast'.
quote: next-intl: Full key autocompletion without requiring codegen... typesafe-i18n: Best-in-class type safety with full codegen and parameter-level checking of plural forms... LinguiJS CLI macro extraction is genuinely fast.
